title: Add 'Auto — pick next incomplete' logic to loop runner
description: When null is passed as the task (Auto mode), the loop runner automatically selects the first incomplete task. If no incomplete tasks remain, shows a completion message and exits.
acceptanceCriteria: Auto mode selects the first incomplete task automatically
When all tasks are complete, shows 'All tasks complete!' message
When all tasks are complete, exits with code 0

steps.description: Handle null task in loop runner
steps.details: In runLoop, if options.task is null: const allTasks = await readTasks(options.agentDir); const incomplete = getIncompleteTasks(allTasks); if (incomplete.length === 0) { yield { type: 'complete', message: 'All tasks complete!' }; return } const task = incomplete[0]
When task selector returns null (Auto), pass null as the task to the loop runner options. The loop runner handles the selection internally.

steps.description: Show completion message in TUI when all complete
steps.details: Add an 'all-complete' state to RocketLoopApp. When the loop yields a completion message for Auto mode with all tasks done, render: <Text color='green' bold>🎉 All tasks complete! Your project is done.</Text>
